project_name: CrediFlux - Gestão Inteligente de Empréstimos Pessoais
target_audience: Personal money lenders, informal creditors, micro-finance managers in Brazil/Portugal requiring fast, reliable loan and payment tracking in Portuguese

hierarchy.metric_large: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight font-mono text-white

colors.archetype: THE PERFORMANCE FINANCIAL COMMAND CENTER (Azul e Preto)

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: relative overflow-hidden before:absolute before:inset-0 before:p-[1px] before:bg-gradient-to-r before:from-blue-500/0 before:via-blue-500/50 before:to-blue-500/0
visual_enhancers.card_hover: transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-blue-500/40 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-blue-500/10

layouts_and_grids.dashboard_summary_bento: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6 mb-8
layouts_and_grids.main_content_layout: min-h-screen bg-[#060A12] text-slate-100 flex flex-col md:flex-row
layouts_and_grids.sidebar: w-full md:w-64 bg-[#0B132B] border-r border-slate-800/80 p-6 flex flex-col justify-between

key_features_ui.dashboard_metrics: Total emprestado (Total Lent), Total recebido (Total Received), Saldo pendente (Pending), Em atraso (Overdue)
key_features_ui.client_table: Interactive client list with filter search, status tabs (Todos, Pago, Pendente, A vencer, Atrasado), sorting, bulk/quick actions
key_features_ui.client_form_modal: Add/Edit Client Form with input validation: Nome, Telefone, Valor Emprestado, Data Empréstimo, Datas de Pagamento, Taxa de Juros (%), Forma de Cobrança (À Vista / Parcelado), Observações
key_features_ui.payment_registration_modal: Mark Payment Received with amount, date, payment method (PIX, Dinheiro, Transferência), and discount/interest adjustments
key_features_ui.client_detail_drawer: Slide-over detail sheet showing client profile, summary statistics, loan terms, and chronological payment timeline
key_features_ui.visual_alerts: High priority alert banner for upcoming payments in 3 days and overdue accounts with quick WhatsApp contact trigger
key_features_ui.auth_page: Sleek dark blue financial login screen with email/password authentication, JWT storage, pre-filled demo credentials, and show/hide password

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow Portuguese language for all UI text and labels (e.g. 'Empréstimos', 'Clientes', 'Registrar Pagamento', 'Atrasado', 'Pago', 'Pendente').
Use formatters for Brazilian Real currency (R$ 0.000,00) and dates (DD/MM/YYYY).
All components must be written in React .js / .jsx format (NOT .tsx).
Ensure every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, modals, table rows, action items, metrics) includes a unambiguous 'data-testid' attribute (kebab-case).
Integrate Shadcn primitives located in @/components/ui/ (Dialog, Sheet, Select, Tabs, Table, Badge, Input, Button, Card, Calendar, Popover, Sonner) with dark theme overrides.
Implement Sonner toast notifications for actions like: 'Cliente adicionado com sucesso', 'Pagamento registrado', 'Status atualizado'.
Add sample Portuguese mock client data (e.g., Carlos Silva, Ana Oliveira, Roberto Santos) so the app looks rich and functional out-of-the-box.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use dark colors as high-contrast flat backgrounds without subtle borders or glass effects.
Do NOT add text-align: center to global App containers.
Use exact micro-interactions for buttons and list items (hover, focus, transition).
Avoid AI slop emojis as primary icons. Use lucide-react icons exclusively (e.g., Wallet, Calendar, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle, Clock, UserPlus, Search, Filter, ArrowUpRight, DollarSign).
Ensure all modals have proper keyboard focus management and dismiss controls.
